node.title: Re^2: How to loop through Plack::Request body_parameters ?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
use strict 'refs' is code smell.

Definitely. [knox]: If you're already working on something as relatively modern as [mod://Plack], then you should definitely also use the modern practices of [id://111088]. There's a reason e.g. [mod://Mojolicious::Lite] turns them on by default.
